en.multiphysics.model_adapt: Refine where the run changes most
en.multiphysics.model_adapt_hint: Reads the shown run's velocity and splits the cells around the tenth of cells where it changes most to a neighbour. Run again to use the finer grid.
en.multiphysics.model_adapt_no_run: Run the study first: adaptive refinement reads a kept run.
en.multiphysics.model_adapt_result: {flagged} of {cells} cells flagged, in {regions} boxes. Run again to use the finer grid.
en.multiphysics.model_add_fan: Put the fan on the selected face
en.multiphysics.model_built: The grid holds {percent} % of the bodies' volume; {regions} fluid regions.
en.multiphysics.model_changed: The model changed since the case was built. Rebuild, or Run rebuilds it.
en.multiphysics.model_current: The case is built from the model as it is now.
en.multiphysics.model_cut_cells_hint: Cells the bodies cut keep their fluid part and a wall face, instead of a staircase of whole cells: thin walls and slanted or curved faces keep their volume and open area (companion 0.14.0). Not yet with heat transfer, porous media, fans or rotating regions.
en.multiphysics.model_external_hint: Around the bodies: the domain is their box plus the margin, and its faces keep the case's inlet and outlet.
en.multiphysics.model_fan_hint: A flat face of the model on the domain boundary, such as a duct's open end: the fan blows in through it against an outlet, following its pressure-flow curve (flow rising, pressure falling). One fan per study.
en.multiphysics.model_flow_hint: Choose the seeds above and press Trace to draw the lines on the model.
en.multiphysics.model_flow_in_graphics: The lines are drawn on the model in the graphics window.
en.multiphysics.model_goal_hint: A face goal uses the face selected in the view (a point goal, the point picked on it). An equation names other goals with + - * / and parentheses. Goal plots show them after a run.
en.multiphysics.model_heat_hint: The bodies conduct heat and the temperature is solved after the flow (conjugate heat transfer; companion 0.15.0 for heat on faces). Not yet with cut cells, or with inlets and outlets on faces inside the domain.
en.multiphysics.model_hint: This study uses the bodies of the open design. Edit the model as usual; the case is built from it again before each run.
en.multiphysics.model_inside_face_hint: A face inside the domain (a vent on an inner wall, a fan outlet) becomes a condition on that body; it needs a companion of version 0.13.0 or later.
en.multiphysics.model_internal_hint: Inside the bodies: the domain is their box, and the fluid is bounded by their walls. Open the vents with conditions on their outer faces.
en.multiphysics.model_leak: Find a leak between the two selected faces
en.multiphysics.model_leak_found: Fluid connects the two faces: the path is drawn in the view.
en.multiphysics.model_leak_hint: Select a face inside the enclosure and one outside it (External, with a margin). The path through the fluid shows where the gap is.
en.multiphysics.model_leak_sealed: No fluid connects the two faces: the enclosure is sealed between them.
en.multiphysics.model_material_starter: No materials yet: every body conducts like the starter material, 1 W/(m·K), without power.
en.multiphysics.model_mesh_level_hint: 3 is the automatic size; each level up makes the cells about 1.4 times smaller (two levels: half the size, about eight times the cells).
en.multiphysics.model_mesh_level_typed: A typed cell size is used now; moving the level goes back to the automatic size at that level.
en.multiphysics.model_no_conditions: No conditions yet: the fluid is sealed in.
en.multiphysics.model_pick_hint: Select one face in the view, then add a condition to it. A flat face on the domain's boundary opens that side of the domain; any other face becomes a condition on its body.
en.multiphysics.model_pick_one: Select exactly one face in the view.
en.multiphysics.model_refine_hint: Select one body or one face in the view. Its cells, and one cell around them, are split; the time step is fitted to the smaller cells.
en.multiphysics.model_show_grid: Show the grid on the model
en.multiphysics.model_thermal_face_hint: Pick a flat face of the model on the domain boundary, such as a duct's open end. For a face inside the domain, add a heat source.
en.multiphysics.model_thermal_faces: Thermal conditions on the domain boundary
en.multiphysics.surface_on_model_too_big: The model has too many display triangles for a surface plot on it.
